svg.title: A member's agent sends a message to her organization's agent, which admits only adult members and learns neither who wrote nor anything on her card

g.text: HANNAH'S SIDE OF THE STREET · HER HOME, HER VAULT, THE KEY SAFE
THE PUBLIC NOTICE BOARD · THE CHAIN
adult · member · tied to the key
the key — it never comes out
the organization's stamp · cards still vouched for
reads mail only from adult members
my agent may prove I'm an adult member

g.style: offset-path:path('M 444.0 358.0 L 547.5 409.8 L 583.5 391.8');offset-rotate:0deg;offset-distance:100%;opacity:1;transition:offset-distance 1.6s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) 2500ms, opacity .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);animation:iso-in .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) 2500ms both

g.text: Adult member? Prove it. Question #4821 — for this door only
her permission covers it — one stamp ✓
for a different organization? no stamp ✗
✉ from a pen name — sealed proof inside
real stamp? card still vouched for? #4821 unused?
a message — from an adult member
its receipt: an adult member wrote · #4821 — no name
her receipt → her vault, with the permission it ran under
she can cancel the permission from her front door — any time
one signed permission: prove "adult member" to this
